A contract for the sale of a photography studio provides that 
the seller 
will not compete with the buyer "for school 
photography work in any school in Grant County, with the 
exception of Marion High School and Bennett High School." 
May the seller compete with the buyer for the photography of 
Marion College students? See Lawrence v. Cain, 245 N.E.2d 
663 (Ind. App. 1969).

Cross, 17 S.W.3d 637 (Tenn. App. 1999).
